rule: Adopt public-repo methods only as feature candidates. Never copy fitted weights. Never put lines, handles, or third-party ratings into Model_P until they beat the frozen engine on walk-forward Brier, log-loss, and CLV.

do_not_copy.why: Uses SP+ and betting lines as features; live 2024 was 48.3% ATS.
Most train on closing spreads. That is leakage relative to SportsEdge Model_P.

adopt_as_method_not_weights.take: EPA/CPOE from PIT play-by-play, hash-bound artifacts, leave-one-season-out.
Barrel, exit velo, platoon, 10/35/75-game windows as feature candidates.
